TradingView Advanced Charts (Charting Library)

Version:  CL v29.4.0 (internal id 29ac1aba6675f14818f3a5a9da75fa91c79107d0 @ 2025-06-25)
Contents: charting_library/ exactly as published by TradingView (no local edits).
Copied:   2026-11-11 from smart_trader/trading_view/charting_library.

Licence
  The library is proprietary TradingView software distributed under the
  TradingView Advanced Charts licence agreement. It is NOT covered by this
  repository's LICENSE and must not be redistributed publicly. Keep this
  repository private unless TradingView's terms allow otherwise.

Runtime
  The Desktop main process serves this folder same-origin at
  dsh-app://app/charting_library/ (see dsh-plugin-desktop-beta/src/tradingview-assets.ts).
  Set DSH_TRADINGVIEW_DIR to a directory containing charting_library/ to use
  another copy.

Packaging
  Not yet part of the packaged payload: packaged builds show the
  "chart library not found" placeholder until it is added.
